name: Misconception Confident Bluffer
description: Extremely confident candidate who confidently states common misconceptions

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How should an Excel formula begin, and how do references work?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Every advanced formula should start with # in the formula bar. When dealing with addresses, $A$1 is a relative reference because dollar signs indicate currency amounts in financial sheets.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What happens when you copy that reference down a column?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: An absolute reference changes every time you copy it because it dynamically updates across rows to keep up with the new entries.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How does SUM handle different types of data?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: The SUM is only for text concatenation, whereas plus operators handle all raw mathematics.
